page.notes: The running head reads "Epist. 5. ad" after the page number 122. The word "Ingenio" at lower right is set in italic display type beside a rule; it is treated as a catchword-like line and may instead be a separate printed word. The word "arridٵent" is a misprint in the scan at the line end: it should read "arrident" with the hyphen-free ending "dent," on the next line; the copy above contains a stray character which should be disregarded. The word "Ingenio" is uncertain as a catchword and may be a headline; if so it should be removed from bottom_margin.
